_fixture.what: Gamma GET /markets?id=..&limit=n answers for the NH, ME and NC Senate legs, SERVED IN ORDER for the same request (the D57 key: the id multiset, limit ignored); the last answer repeats. Answer 0 is what the fair-value refresh validates; answers 1-6 are what the outside-move poll reads every 15 s.
_fixture.prices: NH and ME objects are the existing fixtures' market objects (NH real capture, ME illustrative), trimmed to the fields the providers read. The NC objects are ILLUSTRATIVE (shape copied from the NH capture). Answers 1-3 repeat the refreshed prices; answer 4 moves NC (D) from 0.515/0.525 to 0.575/0.585 (+6 pts, Example L of the spec), answer 5 marks ME (D) closed and leaves NH (R) out (the poll's light checks), answer 6 sends NC (D) liquidityNum as a numeric string below 5,000 (thin). Never treat these as live.
